questions.q: What precise condition triggers a Problem moving into a Known Error state?
options: A permanent fix has already been deployed and verified
An Incident has been open for more than 24 hours
Root cause has been identified, but a permanent fix has not yet been built, tested, or deployed
The Problem has just been created and not yet investigated
questions.explain: Known Error is the middle condition: cause confirmed, fix still pending — not 'still investigating' and not 'actually fixed.'

questions.q: Why does Known Error matter to an agent handling a brand-new, similar Incident?
options: It prevents the new Incident from ever being linked to the Problem
It automatically closes the new Incident with no agent action
It has no effect on how the new Incident is handled
It lets them apply a documented workaround quickly instead of re-investigating from scratch or escalating
questions.explain: The whole value of flagging Known Error is surfacing the workaround to the next agent before they start investigating something already understood.

questions.q: What makes a Known Error record actually deliver its intended value, per this lesson?
options: Being emailed individually to every agent on the team
Being surfaced through Knowledge Management so it appears in an agent's ordinary search results
Being stored only in the Problem table, invisible to search
Being deleted once the workaround is applied once
questions.explain: A Known Error that only lives in the Problem table, with no searchable article, delivers almost none of its intended value.

questions.q: Is documenting a workaround and flagging a Problem as Known Error the same as resolving it?
options: Yes — the Problem should be Closed as soon as a workaround exists
Yes — a workaround is functionally identical to a permanent fix
No — the underlying cause is still present; Known Error is a holding state until a permanent fix is deployed
No — but only because ServiceNow blocks closing any Problem automatically
questions.explain: Closing a Problem as soon as a workaround exists lets the real underlying cause quietly linger, which is exactly the shortcut this lesson warns against.

questions.q: What does Chapter 5 cover that this lesson previews?
options: How to merge the Problem and Incident tables into one table
Generating a knowledge article from a Problem record so a Known Error's workaround surfaces in agent search
How to disable Known Error tracking entirely
How to delete Known Error records once a quarter
questions.explain: The article-generation and search mechanism that makes Known Errors findable is covered in full depth in Chapter 5's Knowledge Management coverage.
